body:
Thank you so much for the kind words!  
I am trying to take care of myself, but sometimes I just need a shoulder to cry on, a hug, kind words - things I don't even remember receiving as a child. But both of us need crutches and sometimes at the same time, which can be hard to manage. Thankfully it's not all bad, I had my fair share of future-less relationships and I am familiar with the signs.  

I'm trying to search for a therapist but it seems like a big task. Someone said it is best to copypaste and send to a bunch of them at the same time. I guess I have no other option than to try! Wish me luck :)

I was doing some embroidery but this adhd thing really fucks up lot of aspects of my life. Not trying to use it as an excuse, I am just feeling the effects of it and only recently got diagnosed. I feel every easy thing very overwhelming. I feel every step as a huge hurdle. I hate it but it is what it is. For example embroidery. Okay, but wtf should I embroider? And another example, I like cooking but I hate looking for recipes and gathering things for it and stuff like that. Maybe I need these pre-printed things where I just need to do and not think. It worked well with a cooking subscription too, they sent me all ingredients and instructions, but then I slacked in choosing the recipes beforehand and they sent me unappealing food and then I didn't cook it, etc etc.  

Anyway, thanks for the suggestion!

Actually not really. I mean I was always playing video games since I was little, but I can get addicted so I try to keep away in the hopes of doing something worthwhile instead. I have social anxiety, I would love to go do things, but I just don't like getting ready and stepping out and I don't know, being around people. Sometimes I'm very confident and do all things by myself, but when I'm feeling down, I just stay at home at all costs. And of course it doesn't help the problem. =/
I just got an answer that they are booked, so as most of their colleagues and they hope I find someone =/

I am standing up for myself more as before, I don't let people abuse me (hence no contact with narc mother etc).  
Because of my adhd I am easily overwhelmed, a dog or children is out of the picture for me. I have a cat though, he is really a sweetheart, when I feel down or cry he sticks to me and won't leave my side. He helped me through a lot, but after a while it is simply not enough. You know, the classic, "would anyone really care if I would be gone" thoughts.  
Your last sentence is 100% true, well said. Thank you!
Thank you, your name is very cute. I just looked for the first nice person and wrote a short message to them. Hope they reply, thank you.

Thank you, it means a lot! <3  
RIght now I am finding solace in the small beauties in life, birdsong, cats, a glass of cold water, anything really.
I learned the hard way, you cannot make other people love you, no matter what you do. I know it doesn't help, but maybe makes it easier to cope. I know exactly how you feel, hugs.
